page.layout: One folding plate, a ground plan drawn with pillars (dotted rings) and labelled keys, occupying the whole scan. At the upper right, beside the plate's right border, a scale bar with a rotated italic caption. At the far right edge, a sliver of the facing printed page, which is not transcribed.
page.notes: Folding plate, ground plan of a building (apparently a temple or sanctuary) with a dotted colonnade around it. The plan carries many single-letter and numeral keys (Roman letters and numbers, including several Hebrew letters, e.g. ב in the block at the lower right). These keys are too small and faint to read reliably, so they are not transcribed. The caption at the upper right is rotated and only partly legible; the second half is illegible. The strip at the far right edge (vertical lettering) belongs to the neighbouring page and is excluded. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
